design_decisions: receive_needed now gates on need_bytes and need_content_items only. Syncthing Counts.TotalItems() includes Deleted, so need_total_items would reintroduce delete gating.
The bytes-only check remains because a non-zero byte count is still missing content; the content-item check keeps an unfinished temp file blocking after Syncthing reports its remaining bytes as zero.
Post-game peer completion remains content-only: a fresh peer with pending deletes still produces an idle, settled sample.
task_2.results: Task 2 is complete and isolated to the receive-needed predicate. Delete-only folder-status tails no longer classify as missing content, while content items and bytes continue to block.
